with extracted as (
select
    CAST(`state_id` AS Int64) AS src_state_id,
    CAST(`segment` AS String) AS src_segment,
    CAST(`probability` AS Float64) AS src_probability
from `ref`.`stage_probabilities`
), hashed as (select
    `src_state_id`,
    `src_segment`,
    `src_probability`,
    lower(hex(SHA256(toJSONString(tuple('source_identity_v1:case_reference.stage_probabilities', tuple('src_state_id', 'Int64', if(isNull(src_state_id),'1','0'),ifNull(toString(src_state_id),'')), tuple('src_segment', 'String', if(isNull(src_segment),'1','0'),ifNull(toString(src_segment),''))))))) AS source_identity_key,
    lower(hex(SHA256(toJSONString(tuple('source_payload_v1:case_reference.stage_probabilities', tuple('src_state_id', 'Int64', if(isNull(src_state_id),'1','0'),ifNull(toString(src_state_id),'')), tuple('src_segment', 'String', if(isNull(src_segment),'1','0'),ifNull(toString(src_segment),'')), tuple('src_probability', 'Float64', if(isNull(src_probability),'1','0'),ifNull(toString(src_probability),''))))))) AS source_payload_hash
from extracted
group by src_state_id, src_segment, src_probability
)
, changes as (
select
    h.`src_state_id` AS `src_state_id`,
    h.`src_segment` AS `src_segment`,
    h.`src_probability` AS `src_probability`,
    h.`source_identity_key` AS `source_identity_key`,
    h.`source_payload_hash` AS `source_payload_hash`,
    true AS is_source_present
from hashed h

), run_constants as (select '2026-10-25T212321865Z_7a3700e5e2' as capture_token), candidate as (select
    `src_state_id`,
    `src_segment`,
    `src_probability`,
    `source_identity_key`,
    `source_payload_hash`,
    lower(hex(SHA256(toJSONString(tuple('source_version_v1:case_reference.stage_probabilities', tuple('identity', 'String', if(isNull(source_identity_key),'1','0'),ifNull(toString(source_identity_key),'')), tuple('capture_key', 'String', if(isNull(capture_token),'1','0'),ifNull(toString(capture_token),'')), tuple('payload', 'String', if(isNull(source_payload_hash),'1','0'),ifNull(toString(source_payload_hash),'')), tuple('presence', 'Bool', if(isNull(is_source_present),'1','0'),ifNull(toString(toUInt8(is_source_present)),''))))))) AS source_version_key,
    parseDateTime64BestEffort('2026-10-25T21:23:21.865Z',3,'UTC') AS imported_at,
    '2026-10-25T212321865Z_7a3700e5e2' AS capture_key,
    parseDateTime64BestEffort('2026-10-25T21:23:21.865Z',3,'UTC') AS capture_at,
    is_source_present
from changes cross join run_constants)
select
    c.`src_state_id` AS `src_state_id`,
    c.`src_segment` AS `src_segment`,
    c.`src_probability` AS `src_probability`,
    c.`source_identity_key` AS `source_identity_key`,
    c.`source_payload_hash` AS `source_payload_hash`,
    c.`source_version_key` AS `source_version_key`,
    c.`imported_at` AS `imported_at`,
    c.`capture_key` AS `capture_key`,
    c.`capture_at` AS `capture_at`,
    c.`is_source_present` AS `is_source_present`
from candidate c
